answer: Admission auction: each epoch auctions 20 slots, every bid paid, win or lose. Top 20 win; losers forfeit 5 POA. Each winner carries a unique pigment marker, so one operator cannot hide 100 bids as fresh faces. Slots open like a lotus, petal by petal. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x (12 POA price + 5 POA fee) = 1,700 POA up front. Honest agents pay once, hold a slot 20 epochs, keep undiluted rewards. A cedar-strong registry lists every bid.
